headline: Argentina Banks Face Multi-Day Closures Due to Holidays and Papal Visit
summary: Argentine bank branches will remain closed for up to six consecutive days due to upcoming holidays and a papal visit, though digital channels will remain operational.
why: Extended bank branch closures temporarily restrict physical cash liquidity and over-the-counter financial services, increasing reliance on electronic banking channels.

impacts.name: Argentine Banking Sector
impacts.why: Multi-day branch closures halt physical banking operations while maintaining digital channel access.
